name: 63050 · Hillsboro, MO
findings: ZIP 63050 (Hillsboro) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63050 (Hillsboro) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 63050 (Hillsboro) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).
